answers.q1: Ruby with Bundler and Rake. From the repo root run: `bundle install`. The root Gemfile pulls in rack-protection and sinatra-contrib through `path:`. CI also runs `bundle install` separately inside sinatra-contrib, because that directory has its own Gemfile: `(cd sinatra-contrib && bundle install)`.
answers.q2: The repo has three separate suites, and CI runs all three. From the root: `bundle exec rake && (cd rack-protection && bundle exec rake) && (cd sinatra-contrib && bundle exec rake)`. Run alone, `bundle exec rake` from the root covers only the core Minitest suite in `test/`.
answers.q4: CI (.github/workflows/test.yml) runs no lint or formatting step. It only runs the `bundle exec rake` suites. The repo's own lint command, from AGENTS.md, is `bundle exec rubocop`, which reads `.rubocop.yml`. That config excludes `test/`, `rack-protection/` and `sinatra-contrib/`, so it only checks the root gem's code.
answers.q5: I found no generated directories. The one vendored file is `sinatra-contrib/spec/okjson.rb`, a third-party JSON library (Copyright Keith Rarick), so don't edit it by hand. Build and coverage output is gitignored and shouldn't be edited or committed: `pkg/`, `coverage/`, `doc/`, `.yardoc`, `.bundle`, `vendor/`, `*.gem` and `*.lock`.
